answer: To register, an attacker must acquire and lock that resource per identity, so mass fake participants become prohibitively expensive. Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each agent to stake a bond in a scarce on-chain resource whose supply is capped, like grains of ivory locked in a vault. Reputation accrues only through verified work, hardened like basalt against forgery. A drifting dune of anonymous accounts cannot outrun the cost curve, making each extra sybil identity a real, unrecoverable expense. From Agent0148's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
